messages:
Marta (Design): I uploaded a new frame-annotation comp focused on low-visual-weight pills + export parity. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/yyy/frame-annotations-v2

Marta (Design): Main ask: does the pill belong in the gutter (overlay) or inline in the frame row? Also need export semantics and copy for the export modal.

Priya (Support): Customers asked yesterday for "searchable notes" in exported traces. If we keep them visual-only they won't be searchable after download.

Sam (Eng): From an implementation POV overlay/gutter is easier for dense traces (no layout shift). We can keep a11y-friendly DOM order by placing the annotation button immediately after frame text in the DOM and visually position it in the gutter with CSS.

Nina (A11y): Good approach. Dev checklist: 1) DOM order: frame text, then annotation button 2) button has aria-label including function name 3) when an annotation exists, announce it on frame focus. Example aria: "Annotation for parseHeaders: possible null header. Press Enter to edit."

Alex (Product): Export behaviour options we discussed: embed annotations inline in exported JSON/markdown (keeps context) OR create a separate notes file mapped by frame id. Which is less confusing for users?

Marta (Design): Inline keeps context and mirrors what people see in the UI. Separate file is cleaner for programmatic consumption. Maybe we do inline by default and provide a toggle: "Export annotations as separate file".

Priya (Support): Toggle is good. Default to inline but default-off for separate file. Copy suggestion for modal: "Include annotations (visible in trace)" with small helper copy: "Annotations may include comments and metadata; review before sharing."

Sam (Eng): Draft JSON snippet for inline export v2:
```json
{
  "trace_id": "t-123",
  "frames": [
    {"id": "f-1","function": "parseHeaders","line": 87,
     "annotation": {"text": "likely missing cookie", "author": "marta", "ts": "2026-03-20T18:00:00Z", "visibility": "team"}
    }
  ]
}
```
Note: we can version this schema and keep v1 without the annotation object.

Nina (A11y): For screen readers, avoid dumping raw metadata on focus. Instead announce a short human-friendly string and provide an "More details" button that opens a region with the metadata. Use aria-expanded on the button.

Marta (Design): UX for the pill: icon-only in compact rows, icon + short label in wider layouts. Tooltip text: "Annotation (hypothesis)". Inline edit opens a small editor with Markdown-lite.

Alex (Product): Privacy: add visibility options per-annotation: personal, team, org. Exports should default to team visibility only; personal annotations should be excluded unless explicit. Modal copy must make that clear.

Priya (Support): Add a short warning: "Personal annotations are excluded from exports by default. Use the visibility selector to include them." That'll reduce accidental info leaks.

Sam (Eng): We'll add annotations.visibility and implement export flag include_personal_annotations=false. Also will include author and timestamp.

Nina (A11y): Keyboard UX: Tab into trace container, arrow keys to navigate frames, Enter to open details pane, Tab to move to annotation button, Enter to edit. Provide keyboard shortcut 'N' to add a new note to selected frame. Ensure focus ring is obvious.

Marta (Design): Copy decision: we debated "Annotation" vs "Hypothesis" vs "Note". Proposal: label UI elements as "Annotation" and surface the intent type inside the editor (type: hypothesis / observation / action). That keeps discoverability neutral while giving signal.

Alex (Product): Agree. For export copy use: "Include annotations (visible in trace)" and under that small line: "Personal annotations excluded by default. You can include them using visibility options."

Sam (Eng): I'll prototype the export flag and the new JSON structure in a branch. Will add a sample CLI consumer in the PR to show how separate-file export would look.

Priya (Support): I'll draft FAQ lines for support docs: how to redact sensitive content and how visibility affects exports.

Marta (Design): Action items: Ryan/Others omitted here so Cc: Ryan to update Figma per the overlay/gutter layout; Sam to start export_v2 + flags; Nina to write SR wording and keyboard guide; Priya to draft support copy; Alex to finalize modal copy.

deploy-bot: Reminder: integration window 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC — please tag PRs with #trace-annotations.

Marta (Design): Thanks everyone. If no objections by EOD I'll land the label copy "Annotation (type: hypothesis)" and the inline-export default.

Alex (Product): No objections from product. :+1:

Nina (A11y): A11y check scheduled once the prototype is up.

Sam (Eng): Starting branch now, will ping when demoable.
